name: Jclaudian
description: Embeds Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents as AI collaborators in your vault, with a three-way chat mode that controls how much of the vault the agent may touch: General (no tools), Vault (read-only search), Agent (full read/write). The Agent mode button also opens a picker for your vault's own slash commands. A fork of Claudian by Yishen Tu.
author: joo (fork) — based on Claudian by Yishen Tu
